Contents:
• 1x Secret Lair x Marvel’s Iron Man Foil Edition
• 1x Secret Lair x Marvel’s Wolverine Foil Edition
• 1x Secret Lair x Marvel’s Storm Foil Edition
• 1x Secret Lair x Marvel’s Captain America Foil Edition
• 1x Secret Lair x Marvel’s Black Panther Foil Edition
